wall_screen.file: 02_人体骨骼晶格肌肉方案/输出/integration_review/s1_series_elbow/nominal_spring_spool_seating_k5_flexor_wall.json

scope: Subdivide segment 8–9 only, in poses with both original supports. Endpoints retain their exterior half-weights and the interior weights use trapezoidal quadrature. The total nominal spring rate for this region is twice the listed node rate at all subdivisions. The summed reaction is a scalar sum, not a vector resultant. The radial springs and guide geometry are a reduced frictionless model.
